SELECT id, content_id, title, content_type_id, area_code, si_gun_gu_code, first_image1, first_image2, map_level, latitude, longitude, tel, addr1, addr2, homepage, overview FROM attractions
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{title}, '%')
AND content_type_id = #{contentTypeId}
ORDER BY title ASC, id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.content_id, a.title, a.content_type_id, a.area_code, a.si_gun_gu_code, a.first_image1, a.first_image2, a.map_level, a.latitude, a.longitude, a.tel, a.addr1, a.addr2, a.homepage, a.overview, b.cal_score FROM attractions a JOIN ( SELECT a.id, COALESCE(SUM(af.score * sfw.weight), 0) AS cal_score FROM attractions a JOIN sidos s ON s.sido_name = #{area} AND a.area_code = s.sido_code LEFT JOIN attraction_features af ON a.id = af.attraction_id LEFT JOIN survey_feature_weight sfw ON af.id = sfw.attraction_features_id
AND sfw.survey_id IN
#{surveyId}
AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY a.id ) b ON a.id = b.id ORDER BY b.cal_score DESC
